detail: CvTdb audit found 17,020 single-point series IDs and 112 potential composite-sampling cross-dose groups. None promoted without original NTP/publication protocol evidence. Primary expansion has 9 comparable series across 5 publications.

ChEBI/UniChem resolved 13 of 15 prioritized source identifiers to full InChIKey and PubChem CID; 2 not found, 238 not queried. Six of seven primary compounds have structures. Increase the configurable identity pass after reviewing remaining CAS/name conflicts.
Seven primary series now have explicit comparable AUC0-inf. HY-071085 AUC0-tn terminal time remains unresolved. AUC tail fractions/individual uncertainty are not uniformly available.
PMC9316000 Table 2 duplicates 1.25 mg/kg headers and IV-like values; prose describes a 2.5 mg/kg group. No silent correction; all dog endpoints outside adapter scope.
Seven primary compounds across five publications remain too few for meaningful molecular or scaffold-disjoint ML. Within-publication compound/route/sex strata are not independent studies.

Legacy anonymous statistics and one-record metadata listing succeeded; inspected human study PKDB00954 is closed-licence. New beta endpoints failed TLS. No preclinical exposure data imported or access restrictions bypassed.

Five additional PMC publications parsed (41 new selected groups); DA-6886 supplementary PDF inspected and contains no new systemic PK data. Additional XML requests PMC89792/PMC4249412 failed after retries. FDA/EMA and wider structured sources remain future work.
Expanded DOI/full-InChIKey overlap screen found zero matches for selected sources, but most CvTdb structures remain unresolved and missing/alias DOIs prevent proof of complete deduplication.

Do not pool singleton animal records into longitudinal curves. Oral DA-9805 pure-component vehicles change with dose and some Cmax units are suspect. Memantine dose volume/composite sampling and AUC labels, and tofacitinib oral vehicle details, keep 8 series outside the primary subset.
EPA original release CC0 and packaged CRAN GPL-3 are recorded separately; derived/raw datasets are not committed. Review distribution-specific obligations before publication.

PubChem REST and ChEBI FTP paths blocked by robots. ChEBI public API and current UniChem API work with crawl delays respected. ChEBI tofacitinib SMILES fails RDKit; its source standard InChI regenerates the expected full key and is retained as an explicit fallback.
